record.question: The materials having same elastic properties in all directions are called -
record.explanation: Isotropic means that the elastic properties at a point are the same in every direction. Homogeneity instead concerns sameness from point to point. Reference: https://archive.nptel.ac.in/content/storage2/courses/105108072/mod02/lec2.html. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
